source: Source revision is unnumbered; site/HTTP timestamps are not a scientific revision identifier.

The Appendix A.2 guarantee is an asymptotic theoretical I/O analysis, with model-not-fitting-on-GPU and no-CPU-computation assumptions. The proof treats KV I/O as constant and ignores small activation I/O; it is not a measured wall-clock guarantee.
Throughput benchmarks use dummy weights; quality evaluations use real weights. Some long benchmark runs project final throughput from fewer generated tokens. These disclosures are retained in full.

Multi-GPU decoding and full-generation throughput have different scaling; compression and offloading gains depend on model size, host capacity and disk/cache conditions. All contrary or qualifying evidence is retained.
